City of Encinitas
City Council - 6:00 p.m.
AGENDA
WEDNESDAY, DECEMBER 12, 2018 -
06:00 PM
p.m.
City of Encinitas - City Council Chambers
505 S. Vulcan Avenue
Encinitas, California 92024
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council.
1.
CALL TO ORDER
2.
ROLL CALL
3.
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE
4.
SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS AND PROCLAMATIONS
4A.
Presentation by Jessica Toth of the Solana Center
5.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS / POSSIBLE DIRECTION TO STAFF (30 MINUTES)
Each speaker is allowed three (3) minutes to address the City Council. Time donations are not permitted during Oral Communications. Please submit a “WHITE” speaker slip to the City Clerk. If at least two (2) Council Members agree, direction may be given to staff to put an item on a future agenda or provide additional information to answer a question.
6.
REPORT FROM CLOSED SESSION (IF HELD)
7.
CHANGES TO THE AGENDA Announcements of administrative changes to the agenda, in compliance with the Brown Act.
The title of ordinances listed on this agenda are deemed to have been read and further reading waived.
8.
CONSENT CALENDAR The recommendations on the following Consent Calendar will be enacted in one motion unless an item is removed from the Calendar. Any member of the public may remove an item by submitting a “PINK” speaker slip to the City Clerk. Items removed from the Consent Calendar by a Council Member or the public will be considered immediately following the Consent Calendar.
If a public hearing item is part of the consent calendar, the public hearing shall be deemed held if the item is not removed from the consent calendar for discussion and possible action.
8A.
Approval of the Minutes of the November 28, 2018 Special City Council Meeting. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Approve the Minutes.
2018-12-12 Item 08A Minutes
8B.
Approval of the Warrants List. Contact Person: Finance Manager Lundgren
Approve the Warrants.
2018-12-12 Item 08B Warrants
8C.
County of San Diego Contract Number 547764 Agreement, amendment number 11 with the City of Encinitas for the Senior Nutrition Program. Contact Person: Senior Center Manager Goodsell
That the City Council authorize the City Manager to execute amendment number 11 of contract number 547764, with the County of San Diego extending the term from January 1, 2019 to June 30, 2019 and increasing estimated revenue to the City by $31,341.
2018-12-12 Item 08C Senior Nutrition Program
8D.
Public Works General Repair Services Spending Authorization Amendment. Contact Person: Contact Person: City Traffic Engineer Bandegan
Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute Contract Amendment #2 with LC Paving & Sealing, Inc. (LC Paving) in substantial form, in the amount of $50,000 annually for general repair services, for a total not to exceed amount of $1,336,500 for the General Mobility Improvement Project (CS18E).
2018-12-12 Item 08D LC Paving
8E.
Capital Project and Grants Update - Capital Improvement Program and Traffic Engineering Divisions. Contact Person: City Engineer Wimmer
Receive the report on the status of Capital Improvement and Traffic Engineering projects and grants.
2018-12-12 Item 08E Mobility Projects and Grants Update
8F.
Santa Fe Drive Corridor Improvements Project (CS19E) budget adjustment and project management authorization. Contact Person: Senior Civil Engineer Kellar
1) Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2018-94 entitled, “A Resolution of the City Council of the City of Encinitas Amending the Fiscal Year 2018-19 Budget”; and 2) Authorize the City Manager or her designee, in coordination with the City Attorney, to execute Contract Amendment #4 with Hoch Consulting in the amount of $88,500 for project management of the Santa Fe Drive Corridor Improvements Project (CS19E), for a total contract amount not to exceed $813,500.
2018-12-12 Item 08F Santa Fe ATP Budget
8G.
Notice of Completion for the South Coast Highway 101 Sidewalk Project (CS15C). Contact Person: Engineer Milligan
1) Accept the public improvements as complete; 2) Authorize release of the performance bond and initiate the warranty bond; and 3) Authorize the filing of a Notice of Completion.
2018-12-12 Item 08G Notice of Completion South Coast Highway 101 Sidewalk Improvements
9.
ITEMS REMOVED FROM THE CONSENT CALENDAR Staff reports will be given only if requested by the person who pulled the item.
10.
ACTION ITEMS
10A.
Discussion and action regarding options for filling the Council seat left vacant by Council Member Tasha Boerner Horvath. Contact Person: City Clerk Hollywood
Council to discuss and provide direction to staff regarding filling the Council vacancy.
2018-12-12 Item 10A Council Vacancy
10B.
Discussion regarding Appointments of Encinitas City Council Members to Regional Boards, Commissions, and Committees, and Consideration and Possible Action Regarding Appointments to Standing Subcommittees, Active Ad-Hoc Subcommittees, and Council Liaisons. Contact Person: Assistant City Manager Delin
1) Council to make recommendations and approve final appointments of Representatives and Alternates to the North County Transit District (NCTD) 2019 Board of Directors; 2) Council to make recommendations and approve final appointments of Representative, Alternate, and Second Alternate to the San Diego Association of Governments (SANDAG) 2019 Board of Directors; 3) Mayor to make recommendations and Council to approve all other 2019 regional board, commission, and committee appointments; and 4) Council to consider and possibly take action regarding appointments to standing subcommittees, active ad-hoc subcommittees, and Council liaisons.
2018-12-12 Item 10B Regional Committee and Board Appointments
10C.
Leucadia Storm Drainage Project. Contact Person: Public Works Director Quiram
Ratify the application for a Caltrans Sustainability Transportation Adaptation Planning Grant in the amount of $393,000 with a City match of $131,000.
2018-12-12 Item 10C Leucadia Storm Drainage Project
10D.
Consideration and possible direction to staff regarding Encinitas Housing Element update litigation outcome (SD Tenants United and Loraine Del-Rose v. City of Encinitas and Encinitas City Council Case No. 37-2017-00013257-CU-WM-NC Government Code 54956.9; and, Building Industry Association of SD (BIA) v. City of Encinitas Case No. 37-2017-00023267-CU-WM-NC). Contact Person: City Attorney Sabine (THERE IS NO AGENDA REPORT FOR THIS ITEM)
Council to discuss and provide possible direction to staff.
2018-12-12 Item 10D Court Ruling regarding petioners BIA & SD Tenants United v COE (Added 12-12-18)
11.
INFORMATIONAL ITEMS
11A.
Update on City of Encinitas’ Economic Development. Contact Person: Assistant City Manager Delin
Receive presentation and provide direction if desired.
2018-12-12 Item 11A Update on Economic Development Program
12.
COUNCIL MEMBER INITIATED AGENDA ITEM
12A.
Council Initiated Item from Mayor Blakespear regarding delivery of marijuana products in the City of Encinitas.
2018-12-12 Item 12A Mayor Blakespear Initiated Item Regarding Delivery of Marijuana Products

ADJOURNMENT - THE NEXT REGULAR CITY COUNCIL MEETING WILL BE HELD ON JANUARY 9, 2019
Notice to the Public:
To ensure that the City meets your needs when addressing the City Council, all presentation materials which require the use of visual equipment need to be submitted to the City's IT Division at least 24 hours in advance of the meeting (except for appeal hearings where materials must be submitted 7 days in advance). This includes photographs, Microsoft Office documents (PowerPoint, Word, Excel). No CD's, DVD's, or USB thumb/flash drives will be accepted at the meeting. All materials must be in PC format and digital presentation items must be emailed to it-service-desk@encinitasca.gov . Please label all materials with the corresponding agenda item number. Should technical assistance be necessary, it will be available to presenters from 5:30 p.m. to 5:50 p.m. on the day of the meeting. Presentation of video/digital/photographs are considered part of the maximum time limit provided to speakers.
